name: pxc04i
transitions: real->protected (CR0.PE 0->1, CS far-jump to 32-bit flat code segment 0x08)
page tables: PT0 identity EXCEPT PT0[0x8E]: linear 0x8E000 -> phys 0x700000 (non-contiguous); PT1[0] present, PT1[1] not-present (the pfault demand-page target); CR3 + CR0.PG 0->1

S_INT_PUSH crossing: ESP=0x8E002 + UD2 -> the 12-byte no-error-code frame spans 0x8DFF6..0x8E001: saved EIP/CS on page 0x8D (identity), saved EFLAGS straddling onto phys 0x700000; the handler verifies saved EIP == the ud2 address and saved CS == 0x08 (marker 0x2038=0x600DF00D) and records EFLAGS/CS for the differential (phys 0x8E000 poisoned 0x0B0B0B0B, phys 0x700000 seeded 0x5A5A5A5A so a wrong-physical-page tail write is observable)

NO not-present/atomicity variant: the frame push IS exception delivery -- a rejecting second page faults the delivery itself, and the nested delivery pushes onto the same stack (ESP unchanged by an aborted delivery), so #PF-during-#PF -> #DF -> triple fault on ANY correct implementation including QEMU; probe-before-commit for writes is covered by pxc04f/pxc04e/pxc04t
pfault flow: demand-page #PF at 0x401000 (restart + readback 0xCAFEBABE), #GP on selector 0x38, #UD on UD2; counters accumulate to 4

witnesses.ecx at exit: 4 -- one #PF (demand-page) + one #GP + two #UD (crossing + pfault) all delivered
witnesses.edx at exit: 0x004000F4 -- CR2 0x401000 captured by the demand-page #PF, low 16 bits clobbered by the 0xF4 exit-port load
witnesses.edi at exit: 0x600DF00D -- the crossing frame's saved EIP (== the ud2 address) and saved CS (== 0x08) verified by the handler from both physical pages
witnesses.ebp at exit: 0x00000008 -- the saved CS dword recorded from the crossing frame
witnesses.ebx at exit: the saved EFLAGS dword (low half phys 0x8DFFE, high half phys 0x700000) -- differential-only, not hard-asserted

description: REVIEW1_Aug3 R2-C03 regression for producer S_INT_PUSH: an exception-frame push straddling a page boundary must land on the correct physical pages and be readable back from both. The trigger is UD2 at ESP=0x8E002; the 12-byte frame straddles 0x8E000, with page 0x8E mapped to the non-adjacent phys frame 0x700000 (wrong-frame poison + right-frame seed make a mis-targeted tail write observable). The handler reads all three frame dwords back and verifies EIP/CS. Differential against QEMU. The not-present variant is architecturally unobservable for this producer (the push IS delivery; a rejecting page faults the delivery recursively into a triple fault on any correct CPU), documented in the test header. Built on the pfault skeleton, whose #PF/#GP/#UD deliveries still run and count.
